A1.justification: Both complete 18-page PDFs describe ChArtist and include Appendix A.1–A.5. Text and rendered pages support a reliable comparison: pages 2–18 match exactly, and the first-page difference is confined to the arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v1 reports original generation experiments, a control-factor ablation, and a 300-participant study in Tables 1–4, with supplementary statistical and qualitative results.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original generation experiments, ablation, participant-study outcomes, and supplementary results.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains the same skeleton representation, spatial and subject LoRA modules, positional encoding, and Spatially-Gated Attention inference procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same CHARTIST-30K dataset covering bar, line and pie charts, and retain the same spatial-only and subject-guided evaluation coverage. The appendix application example is also unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains ControlNet-Canny/Depth, SDEdit and Inpainting. Table 3 retains the ControlNet-plus-IP-Adapter variants, Paint-by-Example, Qwen-Image-Edit, Nano Banana and GPT-Img-1. Human-study comparator membership is unchanged.

E3.justification: Sections 5.1–5.2 and Appendix A.1/A.3 retain identical training and evaluation settings, preprocessing and metrics, including 500 evaluation images per task per chart type and the same 300-participant study protocol.

E4.justification: The beta ablation at 0.3, 0.6 and 0.9 in Table 4 and Figure 8(b), interference examples in Figure 5, and appendix application example are unchanged. No analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Appendix A.2 retains the same Friedman tests and post-hoc Wilcoxon tests with Bonferroni correction; Table S1 retains Kendall tau reporting. Neither version adds or revises seed, repeated-run or uncertainty-reporting information.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–4 and S1 and all qualitative results are identical. For example, ChArtist's dual-control line-chart data accuracy remains 0.905 in Table 3.

T1.justification: The attention and gating equations in Section 4.3 and metric definitions in Appendix A.1, including Equations S1–S3, are identical. No mathematical reasoning or proofs are added, removed or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: skeleton-based chart control, independent or joint spatial and subject control, Spatially-Gated Attention, CHARTIST-30K and a unified data-accuracy metric.

C2.justification: Both versions retain identical interpretations of structural fidelity versus visual expressiveness, background leakage and beta-dependent trade-offs, baseline weaknesses, and applicability within design workflows. No substantive qualification or limitation changes.

D1.justification: Implementation disclosures remain identical, including rank-16 LoRA, 512-by-512 resolution, 25,000 training iterations, two A100 GPUs, baseline parameters and training prompts. The project-page access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 retains identical positioning relative to control representations, controllable generation and visual blending. All 65 numbered reference entries are unchanged.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv marginal stamp changes from v1 dated 15 Mar 2026 to v2 dated 7 May 2026, with its corresponding version link updated. The title, authors, prose, terminology and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–9 and S1–S7, Tables 1–4 and S1, captions and body layout are identical and remain in the same positions. The marginal version/date text update does not alter these displays.

improvement.justification: Only the arXiv version/date stamp and its version link change. The scientific text, experiments, results, presentation and appendices are identical, so v2 provides no meaningful improvement or deterioration in evidential strength, reproducibility or clarity.
